source: one explicit committed Git tree, never the mutable worktree
third_party_sources: Downloaded comparator source snapshots and references/ paper PDFs are excluded. Primary-source URLs, revision IDs and checksums remain in audits. Required dataset attribution and license notices are retained.
manuscripts: Include paperV1-paperV4 sources, styles, bibliography, figures, table dependencies and committed PDFs, including V4 response, exact reviews and cover letter. Superseded versions remain historical.
historical_paths: Absolute machine paths in provenance are historical facts. Offline reproduction takes an explicit extracted --root and requires no such paths.
determinism: Stable Git tree-walk member order after source metadata, 1980-01-01 ZIP timestamps, committed executable modes, deflate level 6. The archive has no embedded outer checksum or self-hashed manifest. External JSON/CSV manifests cover every ZIP member including source metadata.
postassembly_records: Archive ZIP and checksum stay outside Git. A later tracked administrative handoff records manifests, verification and source commit/tree without relabeling the archive as containing that later commit.
